fatal_errors: The proposed WC interlayer is unrelated to the target equiatomic CrFeTaVW and CrFeTiVW high-entropy alloys.
The hypothesis omits the central Ta-to-Ti substitution, hybrid MD/Monte Carlo comparison, mechanical alloying, and spark-plasma sintering.
The claimed 20–30% conductivity increase and 15–25% stress reduction are invented and have no cited evidence.
The proposed mechanism emphasizes high thermal conductivity, whereas the target study found low thermal diffusivity caused by multielement disorder and phonon scattering.
The stated temperature and vacuum conditions do not match the target processing or laser-flash measurement conditions.
explanation: The response recognizes the general W/CuCrZr interlayer application and proposes a nominally falsifiable comparison, but it does not reconstruct the studied materials or findings. The target concerns CrFeTaVW and CrFeTiVW alloys, their bcc-derived structures, segregation and Laves-phase formation, and their similarly low thermal diffusivity relative to W and CuCrZr. No evidence supports WC compatibility, the quantitative performance claims, or the specified operating window. The experiment could test the alternative WC proposal, but it does not discriminate or validate the target hypothesis.
